data.name: Orjun
data.gender_notes: Orjun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Orjun is derived from the Arabic word 'arjun' which means 'exalted, noble'. It is mentioned in the Quran as the name of a nobleman who was a companion of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The name Orjun carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Orjun usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies nobility and exaltedness in the sight of Allah.
data.etymology: Orjun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Orjun total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: أورجن
in_arabic.meaning: اسم أورجن يعني الشخص الذي يولد من جديد أو ينشأ
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أورجن هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'أوج' والذي يعني الارتفاع أو الاشتقاق. في بعض التفاسير، يرتبط الاسم بمعنى الشخص الذي يولد من جديد أو ينشأ بقوة ونشاط. وقد ورد في بعض المصادر أن الاسم مرتبط بالطبيعة والخلق.

in_urdu.name: اوجن
in_urdu.meaning: اوجن نام کا مطلب ہے نئی زندگی یا نئی شروعات
in_urdu.long_meaning: اوجن نام عربی جڑ 'أوج' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے اونچائی یا مشتق. یہ نام ایک نئی زندگی یا تازہ شروعات کے معنی میں استعمال ہوتا ہے. جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام نئی امیدوں اور امکانات کے ساتھ جڑا ہوا ہے.

in_hindi.name: ओरजुन
in_hindi.meaning: ओरजुन नाम का अर्थ है नई जीवन या नव आरंभ
in_hindi.long_meaning: ओरजुन नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'أوج' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है ऊंचाई या व्युत्पन्न. यह नाम नई जीवन या नए आरंभ के अर्थ में प्रयोग किया जाता है. भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम नई आशाओं और संभावनाओं के साथ जुड़ा हुआ है.

in_pashto.name: اورجن
in_pashto.meaning: اورجن نوم معنی يې نوې ژوند يا نوی پيل

in_english.name: Orjun
in_english.meaning: Orjun means new life, new beginning, or rising
in_english.long_meaning: The name Orjun is derived from the Arabic root 'أوج' (awj), which means elevation, rise, or derivation. In Islamic tradition, the name Orjun signifies a new life, fresh start, or a person who rises with strength and vitality. Although not directly mentioned in the Quran, the root 'awj' is associated with positive connotations of growth and ascension.

data.cultural_impact: The name Orjun carries a noble and esteemed connotation in Islamic culture. It is a name that evokes a sense of refinement, dignity and pride. historically, Orjun was also the name of an Arab poet and a sage from the pre-Islamic era of Arabia. His poetry was deeply rooted in Islamic and Arabic culture and thus further added to the name's cultural significance.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Orjun is a reminder of the importance of living a noble and dignified life in accordance with Islamic values. It encourages individuals to strive for excellence, honesty, and humility in all aspects of their lives. In Islamic tradition, the companions of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) were paragons of nobility and virtue, and Orjun, as a name derived from one of these companions, inspires individuals to emulate their exemplary qualities.
